en.headline: Thunderstorm warning carried into early Saturday
en.dek: The Observatory's 2am bulletin kept the warning in force until 3am, with isolated storms and heavy pockets of rain.
body: A thunderstorm warning remained in force into the early hours of Saturday after the Hong Kong Observatory extended the signal issued at 3:55pm on Friday. In its weather report at 2:02am, the Observatory said the warning was valid until 3am on Saturday and that isolated thunderstorms were expected in parts of Hong Kong.

The same bulletin put the temperature at the Observatory at 27 degrees and relative humidity at 89 per cent, with the weather icon set to rain. Between 12:45am and 1:45am, recorded rainfall ranged from none to 19 millimetres in Sha Tin, none to 9 millimetres in Wong Tai Sin, and lighter amounts across Tsuen Wan, Tuen Mun and Kowloon City.

The Observatory's local forecast for Saturday, updated at midnight, said the day would be mainly cloudy with occasional showers, heavy in some areas in the morning with a few thunderstorms. Temperatures were expected to range between 27 and 31 degrees under moderate easterly winds. The outlook still called for a few showers on Sunday, with winds freshening from the north at night and mornings turning slightly cooler early next week.

The public advice attached to the warning is the usual set: seek shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or water sports, and stay off high ground and away from trees, masts and other conductive objects while thunderstorms are nearby.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延至周六凌晨生效
zh.dek: 天文台凌晨2時天氣報告指警告有效至上午3時，本港局部地區仍有雷暴，沙田錄得較大雨量。
body: 周五下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告一直維持至周六凌晨。香港天文台在周六凌晨2時02分的天氣報告表示，警告有效至上午3時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
同一份報告指，上午2時天文台錄得氣溫27度，相對濕度百分之89，天氣插圖為雨。凌晨零時45分至1時45分，沙田錄得0至19毫米雨量，黃大仙0至9毫米，荃灣、屯門及九龍城亦有數毫米雨量，其餘多區雨勢較細。
天文台午夜更新的本港預報指，周六大致多雲，間中有驟雨，早上部分地區雨勢頗大及有幾陣雷暴，氣溫介乎27至31度，吹和緩偏東風。展望周日仍有幾陣驟雨，晚上北風增強；隨後兩三日早上稍涼，最低氣溫約降至24度，下周中期漸轉天晴乾燥。
雷暴警告下的一般呼籲仍然適用：在戶外應尋找安全地方躲避，離開水面，不要在戶外游泳或進行其他水上活動，亦不要站在高地，並遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
